note: The fixture pair for unbounded-query (L02 in fixtures/PLAN.md), raw SQL through pg form, scanned with unbounded-query alone. Written by hand: each planted defect is fixed in place in the clean twin, line for line, and the twins differ in nothing else. A finding catches a defect when its check matches and its locations name the defect's file, line, column and symbol (every place, when the defect lists several), with the defect's severity. Decoys are in both twins; reporting one is a false positive. erlang.config.json names the settings table as small, so reading all of it is not reported. Unique columns are read from migrations/001_init.sql. Paths are relative to each twin. Nothing here is installed or run.
